title: Thesis Proposal: Toward a Human-Centered and Perspective-Aware Framework for Reproducible ML Evaluation and AI Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating in-group and cross-group rater cohesion and vicarious alignment (using metrics like Inter-Rater Reliability, Cross-Rater Reliability, and Negentropy) on perceptions of personal and vicarious offense across different political affiliations (Democrats, Republicans, Independents).

Comparing rater cohesion and disagreement in annotating offensive text across gender groups (Men, Women) and measuring how perceptions of offense vary at the intersection of gender and political affiliation.
